newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica ahead on busines loan schedule.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica ahead on busines loan schedule.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said it is almost two-thirds of the way to the $10.6 billion, three-year commitment it made to small businesses a year ago.
Between April 1, 1996, and March 31, 1997, BankAmerica said it made $6.6 billion in small-business loans in 10 western states.
During the same period, the bank loaned more than $3.9 billion to small businesses in California, approaching its three-year, $4.5 billion commitment there.
